comments.why: Diatoms produce a quarter to half of Earth's oxygen, shown in video
comments.text: For anyone interested in learning about phytoplankton and other microorganisms, I highly recommend the YouTube series Journey to the Microcosmos , [LINK] For example this video about diatoms, which are responsible for a quarter to half of the oxygen produced on earth, [VIDEO] [LINK] Seeing high-quality video of things moving around gives a much more visceral impression than just reading text interspersed with static images, in my opinion.
